scope.core: Looped, recursive, and recurrent-depth Transformer research, including direct theory, analysis, systems, and applications.
scope.broader: A selective track of latent-reasoning work that performs multi-step computation in learned hidden states without necessarily using a looped Transformer.

papers.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks

summary.en: Introduces a differentiable halting mechanism that lets recurrent models spend different amounts of computation on different inputs.
summary.zh: 提出可微分的停止机制，使循环模型能够针对不同输入动态分配计算步数。

papers.title: Universal Transformers

summary.en: Establishes the canonical depth-recurrent Transformer: one shared transition repeatedly refines every token, optionally with adaptive halting.
summary.zh: 奠定深度循环 Transformer 的经典形式：共享变换反复更新各 token，并可结合自适应停止。

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Models
papers.authors: Shaojie Bai, J. Zico Kolter, Vladlen Koltun

summary.en: Treats infinitely deep weight-tied networks as fixed-point systems, providing an implicit-depth counterpart to explicitly unrolled loops.
summary.zh: 把无限深的权重共享网络视为不动点系统，为显式展开循环提供隐式深度的对应框架。

papers.title: Looped Transformers as Programmable Computers

summary.en: Constructs constant-size Transformer blocks that execute iterative programs when looped, making the computational role of recurrent depth explicit.
summary.zh: 构造可在循环中执行迭代程序的常数规模 Transformer 块，明确展示循环深度的计算能力。

papers.title: Looped Transformers are Better at Learning Learning Algorithms

summary.en: Shows that repeatedly applying a small shared Transformer can learn iterative in-context fitting algorithms with far fewer parameters than a deep untied model.
summary.zh: 表明小型共享 Transformer 经多次循环后可以学习迭代式上下文拟合算法，并显著减少参数量。

papers.title: AlgoFormer: An Efficient Transformer Framework with Algorithmic Structures

summary.en: Combines task-specific pre- and post-processing blocks with a reusable middle block, injecting an iterative algorithmic prior into Transformer learning.
summary.zh: 用任务相关的前后处理模块包围可复用的中间循环块，把迭代算法先验注入 Transformer。

papers.title: MoEUT: Mixture-of-Experts Universal Transformers

summary.en: Adds sparse expert capacity and improved recurrent dynamics to Universal Transformers, narrowing the quality gap with standard language models.
summary.zh: 在 Universal Transformer 中加入稀疏专家与改进的循环机制，缩小其与常规语言模型的性能差距。

papers.title: Looped Transformers for Length Generalization

summary.en: Trains a decoder-only looped Transformer to match iteration count to problem length, enabling strong extrapolation on iterative algorithmic tasks.
summary.zh: 训练解码器式循环 Transformer 让循环次数随问题长度变化，从而在迭代算法任务上获得更强的长度外推。

papers.title: On Expressive Power of Looped Transformers: Theoretical Analysis and Enhancement via Timestep Encoding

summary.en: Derives approximation guarantees and a loop-specific limitation, then uses timestep-conditioned scaling to give repeated blocks distinct behavior.
summary.zh: 推导循环 Transformer 的逼近保证与特有瓶颈，并用时间步条件调制让共享块在不同循环中产生差异化行为。

papers.title: Bypassing the Exponential Dependency: Looped Transformers Efficiently Learn In-context by Multi-step Gradient Descent

summary.en: Proves that linear looped Transformers can implement multi-step gradient descent for in-context learning without requiring exponentially many demonstrations.
summary.zh: 证明线性循环 Transformer 能用多步梯度下降完成上下文学习，而不需要指数数量的示例。

papers.title: Relaxed Recursive Transformers: Effective Parameter Sharing with Layer-wise LoRA

summary.en: Folds pretrained Transformers into repeated blocks and restores depth-specific flexibility with small LoRA adapters, while motivating continuous depth-wise batching.
summary.zh: 把预训练 Transformer 折叠为重复块，再用轻量 LoRA 恢复层间差异，并提出连续深度批处理的设想。

papers.title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach

summary.en: Scales recurrent depth to a 3.5B-parameter, 800B-token language model and shows that extra test-time loops can improve reasoning without emitting more tokens.
summary.zh: 把循环深度扩展到 35 亿参数、8000 亿 token 的语言模型，并显示增加测试时循环可在不生成更多 token 的情况下增强推理。

papers.title: Reasoning with Latent Thoughts: On the Power of Looped Transformers

summary.en: Connects recurrence to latent multi-step reasoning theoretically and empirically, showing that effective depth can matter more than unique parameter depth.
summary.zh: 从理论与实验上连接循环和隐空间多步推理，指出有效计算深度可能比独立参数层数更关键。

papers.title: To CoT or To Loop? A Formal Comparison Between Chain-of-Thought and Looped Transformers

summary.en: Separates the strengths of the two compute axes: loops efficiently simulate parallel deterministic computation, while stochastic CoT favors some self-reducible problems.
summary.zh: 形式化区分两种计算扩展方式：循环更擅长并行确定性计算，而随机 CoT 在部分自归约问题上更有优势。

papers.title: Latent Chain-of-Thought? Decoding the Depth-Recurrent Transformer

summary.en: Probes Huginn across recurrent steps to test whether its hidden-state trajectory behaves like a decodable latent chain of thought.
summary.zh: 沿 Huginn 的循环步探测隐藏状态，检验其轨迹是否形成可解码的潜在思维链。

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop it? Test-Time Depth Adaptation of Pretrained LLMs
papers.authors: Ziyue Li, Yang Li, Tianyi Zhou

summary.en: Studies inference-time layer skipping and repetition in pretrained LLMs, treating the existing stack as a flexible depth program rather than a fixed path.
summary.zh: 研究预训练大模型在推理时跳过或重复层，把既有层栈视为可调整的深度程序而非固定路径。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Recursions: Learning Dynamic Recursive Depths for Adaptive Token-Level Computation

summary.en: Routes each token to a learned recursion depth inside a shared Transformer stack, coupling parameter reuse with token-level sparse computation.
summary.zh: 在共享 Transformer 层栈中为每个 token 学习递归深度，把参数复用与 token 级稀疏计算结合起来。

papers.title: Two-Scale Latent Dynamics for Recurrent-Depth Transformers

summary.en: Introduces fast and slow latent dynamics so a recurrent-depth model can separate local refinement from longer-horizon state evolution.
summary.zh: 引入快慢两种隐状态动力学，让循环深度模型分离局部细化与长程状态演化。

papers.title: What Makes Looped Transformers Perform Better Than Non-Recursive Ones

summary.en: Uses loss-landscape geometry to explain an optimization advantage of recurrent attention and turns the analysis into a staged training strategy.
summary.zh: 从损失景观几何解释循环注意力的优化优势，并据此提出分阶段训练方法。

papers.title: Parallel Loop Transformer for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling

summary.en: Overlaps loop steps across tokens and combines first-loop KV sharing with gated sliding-window attention to reduce sequential latency and cache overhead.
summary.zh: 通过跨 token 重叠执行循环步，并结合首轮 KV 共享与门控滑动窗口注意力，降低串行延迟与缓存开销。

papers.title: Scaling Latent Reasoning via Looped Language Models

summary.en: Introduces Ouro, pretrained looped language models with entropy-regularized depth allocation, and studies recurrent depth as a distinct scaling direction.
summary.zh: 提出 Ouro 预训练循环语言模型，以熵正则进行深度分配，并把循环深度作为独立的扩展维度研究。

papers.title: Teaching Pretrained Language Models to Think Deeper with Retrofitted Recurrence

summary.en: Converts dense pretrained models into recurrent-depth models through continued training, testing how much loop behavior can be installed after pretraining.
summary.zh: 通过继续训练把稠密预训练模型改造成循环深度模型，检验能否在预训练后补装循环推理能力。

papers.title: Think-at-Hard: Selective Latent Iterations to Improve Reasoning Language Models

summary.en: Uses a lightweight decider to select hard tokens for additional latent iterations, with depth-aware LoRA and duo-causal attention supporting targeted refinement.
summary.zh: 用轻量决策器为困难 token 选择额外的隐空间迭代，并结合深度感知 LoRA 与双因果注意力进行针对性细化。

papers.title: Depth-Recurrent Attention Mixtures: Giving Latent Reasoning the Attention it Deserves

summary.en: Diversifies the attention transformations available across repeated depth while preserving a recurrent core.
summary.zh: 在保留循环核心的同时，为不同重复深度提供更丰富的注意力变换。

papers.title: Recurrent-Depth VLA: Implicit Test-Time Compute Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Latent Iterative Reasoning

summary.en: Applies recurrent-depth latent refinement to embodied vision-language-action policies so inference compute can scale without longer action traces.
summary.zh: 把循环深度的隐空间细化用于视觉—语言—动作策略，使推理计算可扩展而无需生成更长动作轨迹。

papers.title: Understanding Dynamic Compute Allocation in Recurrent Transformers

summary.en: Uses controlled algorithmic tasks to measure whether learned token-wise depth tracks difficulty and whether the routing policy extrapolates.
summary.zh: 用受控算法任务衡量 token 级动态深度是否对应难度，以及路由策略能否外推。

papers.title: Looping Back to Move Forward: Recursive Transformers for Efficient and Flexible Large Multimodal Models

summary.en: Builds a multimodal recursive Transformer with modality-aware state alignment and supervision that encourages quality to improve with each loop.
summary.zh: 构建多模态递归 Transformer，通过模态感知的状态对齐和逐轮监督推动性能随循环改善。

papers.title: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation

summary.en: Trains loop trajectories of different lengths to agree, enabling one model to operate smoothly across inference budgets.
summary.zh: 约束不同长度的循环轨迹保持一致，使同一模型能在多种推理预算下平滑工作。

papers.title: SpiralFormer: Looped Transformers Can Learn Hierarchical Dependencies via Multi-Resolution Recursion

summary.en: Runs successive recurrences at multiple sequence resolutions, turning resolution into another axis for efficient hierarchical computation.
summary.zh: 在多种序列分辨率上执行递归，把分辨率变成高效层次计算的新维度。

papers.title: AdaPonderLM: Gated Pondering Language Models with Token-Wise Adaptive Depth

summary.en: Learns token-wise pondering gates so a shared language-model block can stop easy tokens early and continue refining harder ones.
summary.zh: 学习 token 级思考门控，使共享语言模型块能让简单 token 提前停止、困难 token 继续细化。

papers.title: Thinking Deeper, Not Longer: Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Compositional Generalization

summary.en: Tests whether recurrent latent depth, rather than longer decoded rationales, improves systematic composition outside the training distribution.
summary.zh: 检验循环隐空间深度能否比更长的显式推理文本更好地提升分布外系统组合能力。

papers.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Reasoning Language Models

summary.en: Tracks representations through repeated blocks in models such as Ouro and Huginn, identifying recurring inference stages and convergence patterns.
summary.zh: 跟踪 Ouro、Huginn 等模型的循环表示，识别反复出现的推理阶段与收敛模式。

papers.title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models

summary.en: Diagnoses residual instability through the loop’s dynamical system and constrains injection operators to obtain more predictable training and test-time scaling.
summary.zh: 从循环动力系统角度诊断残差不稳定，并约束注入算子以获得更可预测的训练和测试时扩展。

papers.title: Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers

summary.en: Characterizes how recall connections and normalization affect reachable, input-dependent fixed points and depth generalization.
summary.zh: 刻画回忆连接与归一化如何影响可达、依赖输入的不动点及深度泛化。

papers.title: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models

summary.en: Quantifies the quality value of a repeated layer relative to a unique layer under matched effective depth and training compute.
summary.zh: 在匹配有效深度与训练计算的条件下，量化重复层相对于独立层的性能价值。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer: Decoupling Compute from Memory in Looped Language Models

summary.en: Redesigns recurrent inference so adding loop computation does not force proportional growth in stored intermediate state.
summary.zh: 重构循环推理，使增加循环计算不再要求中间状态存储按比例增长。

papers.title: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models

summary.en: Finds that adding sparse capacity is especially important when scaling recurrent language models, improving their quality–memory trade-off and exit behavior.
summary.zh: 发现稀疏容量对循环语言模型扩展尤为关键，可改善质量—内存权衡及提前退出表现。

papers.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models

summary.en: Transforms an existing pretrained LLM into a looped latent-refinement model instead of training recurrent depth entirely from scratch.
summary.zh: 把现有预训练大模型改造成循环隐空间细化模型，避免完全从头训练循环深度。

papers.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer

summary.en: Studies a fully recurrent design and a simplified stabilization recipe intended to avoid fragile partial-loop dynamics.
summary.zh: 研究全循环架构与简化稳定方案，旨在规避部分循环设计中的脆弱动力学。

papers.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers

summary.en: Combines recurrent depth with linear-time sequence mixing to prevent long-context attention cost from multiplying across loops.
summary.zh: 把循环深度与线性时间序列混合结合，避免长上下文注意力开销随循环次数成倍增加。

papers.title: Training-Free Looped Transformers

summary.en: Loops frozen mid-stack layers at inference as damped numerical refinement steps, showing that useful recurrence can sometimes be added without training.
summary.zh: 在推理时把冻结的中间层作为阻尼数值细化步骤循环，显示某些循环能力可在无需训练时加入。

papers.title: Stabilizing Recurrent Dynamics for Test-Time Scalable Latent Reasoning in Looped Language Models

summary.en: Regularizes the loop Jacobian while sampling depths during training, targeting stable improvement when inference uses more iterations than training.
summary.zh: 在训练中采样循环深度并正则化循环 Jacobian，目标是在推理循环超过训练范围时仍能稳定提升。

papers.title: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling

summary.en: Couples repeated shared computation with sparse expert routing, seeking both iterative refinement and expandable parameter capacity.
summary.zh: 把共享计算的重复迭代与稀疏专家路由结合，同时追求迭代细化与可扩展参数容量。

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs
papers.authors: Ziyue Li, Yang Li, Tianyi Zhou

summary.en: Learns input-conditioned programs that can traverse, skip, or revisit modules from a pretrained Transformer stack.
summary.zh: 学习由输入条件决定的层程序，可在预训练 Transformer 层栈中顺序执行、跳过或回访模块。

papers.title: LoopCoder: Scaling Code Intelligence via Looped Language Models

summary.en: Scales looped pretraining and post-training to a 40B-total/8B-active coding model, using dense-to-loop initialization for stability.
summary.zh: 把循环式预训练与后训练扩展到总参数 400 亿、激活参数 80 亿的代码模型，并用稠密到循环初始化增强稳定性。

papers.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling

summary.en: Compares parallel-loop counts at 7B scale and finds a non-monotonic trade-off: one repeated pass captures most gains before positional mismatch dominates.
summary.zh: 在 70 亿规模比较并行循环次数，发现收益并不单调：一次重复已获得主要提升，更多循环会受位置错配影响。

papers.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers

summary.en: Trains deep looped Transformers around stable attractors so inference can stop by convergence rather than a fixed iteration count.
summary.zh: 围绕稳定吸引子训练深循环 Transformer，使推理可依据收敛而非固定迭代次数停止。

papers.title: On the Residual Scaling of Looped Transformers: Stability and Transferability

summary.en: Shows that correlated reuse changes residual-growth laws and derives loop-aware scaling that supports stable depth and hyperparameter transfer.
summary.zh: 指出权重重复造成的相关更新会改变残差增长规律，并推导支持稳定深度与超参数迁移的循环感知缩放。

papers.title: Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping

summary.en: Randomizes supervised stopping depth and learns when to halt, reducing sensitivity to a single training horizon on length-generalization tasks.
summary.zh: 随机化训练监督的停止深度并学习何时停止，降低长度泛化对单一训练循环数的敏感性。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Latent and Explicit Reasoning with Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Ying Fan, Anej Svete, Kangwook Lee

summary.en: LOTUS supervises parallel latent slots against explicit reasoning steps, bringing latent looped reasoning closer to chain-of-thought quality with lower thought latency.
summary.zh: LOTUS 用显式推理步骤并行监督潜变量，使循环隐推理更接近 CoT 质量，同时降低思考阶段延迟。

papers.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers

summary.en: Derives residual initialization rules based on how often shared parameters are revisited, stabilizing deeply unrolled post-LN Transformers.
summary.zh: 依据共享参数被访问的次数推导残差初始化规则，稳定深度展开的 Post-LN 循环 Transformer。

papers.title: Looped Latent Attention: Cross-Loop KV Compression for Looped Transformers

summary.en: Compresses the trajectory of keys and values across loop iterations into a compact latent representation for higher serving capacity.
summary.zh: 把不同循环中的 K/V 轨迹压缩到紧凑隐表示中，以提高循环模型的服务容量。

papers.title: Loop the Loopies!

summary.en: Develops a large-scale looped MoE recipe that reinvests parameter-memory savings while comparing against compute-matched sparse baselines.
summary.zh: 提出大规模循环 MoE 配方，把参数内存节省重新投入训练，并与计算匹配的稀疏基线比较。

papers.title: LoopMTP: A Looped Transformer Guided by Latent Multi-Token Prediction

summary.en: Aligns each loop state with progressively farther future tokens, adding dense guidance intended to reduce undirected refinement and overthinking.
summary.zh: 让每轮状态对齐更远的未来 token，以密集监督减少无方向的隐状态细化与过度思考。

papers.title: Depth-Adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching

summary.en: Turns variable recurrent depth into a serving primitive by continuously batching examples that enter and leave at different loop counts.
summary.zh: 把可变循环深度变成服务系统原语，持续批处理在不同循环次数进入和退出的样本。

papers.title: Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation

summary.en: Modulates a shared recurrent core with a learned update gate and fresh noise, allowing repeated applications to specialize by step.
summary.zh: 用学习到的更新门和逐步噪声调制共享循环核心，使同一模块在不同循环中形成专门化。

papers.title: Recirculation

summary.en: Adds a distinct inference-time recurrence to frozen foundation models during prefill, targeting belief-state tracking without generation-time latency.
summary.zh: 在冻结基础模型的预填充阶段加入一种不同于常规深度循环的递归，改善信念状态跟踪且不增加生成阶段延迟。

papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling

summary.en: Evaluates recurrent depth on tool-use tasks and finds its clearest gains when calls have compositional or dependency structure.
summary.zh: 在工具调用任务上评估循环深度，发现其收益主要出现在具有组合或依赖结构的调用中。

papers.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth

summary.en: Classifies recurrent dynamics and introduces a terminal fixed-point objective to make extra test-time depth safer and more reliable.
summary.zh: 分类循环动力学，并引入终端不动点目标，使额外测试时深度更安全可靠。

papers.title: Allocating Recurrent Compute in Looped Language Models

summary.en: Asks which sublayer should recur and finds that repeatedly applying the sequence mixer can retain much of the loop benefit without repeating every FFN.
summary.zh: 追问究竟哪些子层应循环，发现只重复序列混合器可保留大量循环收益，而无需每轮都执行 FFN。

papers.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers

summary.en: Evaluates looped MoE models while jointly matching FLOPs, non-embedding parameters, and KV cache, separating architectural effects from extra compute.
summary.zh: 在同时匹配 FLOPs、非嵌入参数量和 KV 缓存的条件下评估循环 MoE，区分架构收益与额外计算收益。

papers.title: Simulation of Graph Algorithms with Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Artur Back de Luca, Kimon Fountoulakis

summary.en: Constructs looped Transformers that execute shortest-path, traversal, and connectivity algorithms on arbitrary-size graphs, while making finite-precision limits explicit.
summary.zh: 构造可在任意规模图上执行最短路、遍历和连通性算法的循环 Transformer，并明确讨论有限精度带来的限制。

papers.title: Can Looped Transformers Learn to Implement Multi-step Gradient Descent for In-context Learning?

summary.en: Moves beyond construction results by analyzing optimization: population-risk minimizers and gradient flow learn a data-adapted multi-step preconditioned gradient method.
summary.zh: 从可表达性推进到可学习性分析：总体风险最优解与梯度流会学习适应数据分布的多步预条件梯度法。

papers.title: Transformers Learn to Implement Multi-step Gradient Descent with Chain of Thought
papers.authors: Jianhao Huang, Zixuan Wang, Jason D. Lee

summary.en: Analyzes how CoT training induces multi-step in-context gradient descent and uses the same tools to show a performance gain from looping.
summary.zh: 分析 CoT 训练如何诱导多步上下文梯度下降，并用同一套理论工具说明循环带来的性能提升。

papers.title: A Little Depth Goes a Long Way: The Expressive Power of Log-Depth Transformers

summary.en: Shows that a universally shared block unrolled only logarithmically with input length can recognize regular languages and solve graph connectivity beyond fixed-depth limits.
summary.zh: 证明共享模块只需随输入长度对数级展开，就能识别正则语言并解决超出固定深度能力边界的图连通问题。

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Layer Normalization Provably Learn the Power Method
papers.authors: Lyumin Wu, Chenyang Zhang, Yuan Cao

summary.en: Proves that gradient descent selects a looped, layer-normalized solution implementing one power iteration per attention application.
summary.zh: 证明梯度下降会选择一种带 LayerNorm 的循环解，使每次注意力调用对应一次幂迭代。

papers.title: Let’s Think Dot by Dot: Hidden Computation in Transformer Language Models

summary.en: Uses semantically empty filler tokens to expose additional Transformer computation without requiring a verbalized rationale.
summary.zh: 使用语义为空的填充 token 为 Transformer 提供额外计算步，而无需生成语言化推理过程。

papers.title: From Explicit CoT to Implicit CoT: Learning to Internalize CoT Step by Step

summary.en: Progressively removes explicit reasoning steps during training so their function is absorbed into hidden computation.
summary.zh: 在训练中逐步移除显式推理步骤，使其功能被模型内部的隐式计算吸收。

papers.title: Uncovering Latent Chain of Thought Vectors in Language Models

summary.en: Derives activation directions associated with chain-of-thought behavior and uses them to steer reasoning without a natural-language trigger.
summary.zh: 提取与思维链行为相关的激活方向，并用它在不依赖自然语言提示的情况下引导推理。

papers.title: Language Models are Hidden Reasoners: Unlocking Latent Reasoning Capabilities via Self-Rewarding

summary.en: Optimizes hidden reasoning behavior with self-generated preference signals instead of requiring every intermediate step to be written out.
summary.zh: 利用模型自生成的偏好信号优化隐式推理行为，而不要求把每个中间步骤写出来。

papers.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space

summary.en: Coconut feeds a generated hidden state back as the next input embedding, creating a continuous chain of thought that can represent multiple candidate paths.
summary.zh: Coconut 把生成的隐藏状态直接作为下一步输入嵌入，形成可同时承载多个候选路径的连续思维链。

papers.title: Compressed Chain of Thought: Efficient Reasoning through Dense Representations

summary.en: Compresses longer textual reasoning traces into fewer dense representations to reduce autoregressive reasoning cost.
summary.zh: 把较长的文本推理轨迹压缩成更少的稠密表示，以降低自回归推理成本。

papers.title: Efficient Reasoning with Hidden Thinking

summary.en: Learns compact hidden reasoning states that replace portions of an explicit chain while retaining answer quality.
summary.zh: 学习紧凑的隐藏推理状态，替代部分显式思维链并尽量保持答案质量。

papers.title: Token Assorted: Mixing Latent and Text Tokens for Improved Language Model Reasoning

summary.en: Interleaves continuous latent tokens with ordinary text tokens, exploring a hybrid medium between silent and explicit reasoning.
summary.zh: 交错使用连续潜 token 与普通文本 token，探索静默推理和显式推理之间的混合媒介。

papers.title: CODI: Compressing Chain-of-Thought into Continuous Space via Self-Distillation

summary.en: Self-distills explicit rationales into continuous hidden trajectories so the model can reason with fewer decoded tokens.
summary.zh: 通过自蒸馏把显式推理压入连续隐藏轨迹，使模型用更少的解码 token 完成推理。

papers.title: Soft Thinking: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of LLMs in Continuous Concept Space

summary.en: Propagates soft vocabulary distributions as continuous concept representations instead of committing to a single discrete reasoning token.
summary.zh: 把词表上的软分布作为连续概念表示传递，避免每一步都过早确定为单个离散推理 token。

papers.title: Hybrid Latent Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Uses reinforcement learning to combine sampled tokens with prior hidden states, preserving discrete generation while introducing latent computation.
summary.zh: 用强化学习融合采样 token 和先前隐藏状态，在保留离散生成的同时引入隐空间计算。

papers.title: PonderLM: Pretraining Language Models to Ponder in Continuous Space

summary.en: Learns continuous pondering during pretraining by feeding a probability-weighted sum of token embeddings back into additional forward passes before emitting a token.
summary.zh: 在预训练中学习连续思考，将预测分布加权得到的 token 嵌入回送模型，在输出 token 前执行额外的前向计算。

papers.title: Parallel Continuous Chain-of-Thought with Jacobi Iteration

summary.en: Uses Jacobi-style updates to refine multiple continuous thought positions in parallel rather than generating a serial rationale.
summary.zh: 使用 Jacobi 式更新并行细化多个连续思维位置，而不是串行生成推理文本。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model

summary.en: Uses two recurrent modules operating at different timescales to solve difficult symbolic tasks with a compact non-Transformer reasoner.
summary.zh: 使用工作在不同时间尺度的两个循环模块，以紧凑的非 Transformer 推理器解决高难符号任务。

papers.title: A Survey on Latent Reasoning

summary.en: Surveys activation recurrence, hidden-state propagation, compressed reasoning, and implicit-depth approaches across the broader latent-reasoning landscape.
summary.zh: 系统梳理激活循环、隐藏状态传递、压缩推理与隐式深度等更广泛的潜在推理路线。

papers.title: SynAdapt: Learning Adaptive Reasoning in Large Language Models via Synthetic Continuous Chain-of-Thought

summary.en: Creates synthetic continuous-thought targets and invokes additional reasoning only when a learned difficulty signal marks an example as hard.
summary.zh: 构造合成连续思维监督目标，并仅在学习到的难度信号判定问题较难时追加推理。

papers.title: SIM-CoT: Supervised Implicit Chain-of-Thought

summary.en: Trains implicit reasoning states with supervision derived from explicit chain-of-thought trajectories.
summary.zh: 利用显式思维链轨迹派生的监督信号训练隐式推理状态。

papers.title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks

summary.en: Proposes the Tiny Recursive Model: a small shared network alternately refines a latent state and a candidate answer, with both self-attention and attention-free variants evaluated on structured reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: 提出 Tiny Recursive Model：用小型共享网络交替更新隐状态与候选答案，并在结构化推理任务上比较自注意力与无注意力两种实现。

papers.title: LLM Latent Reasoning as Chain of Superposition

summary.en: Constrains latent thoughts to superpositions in vocabulary space, adding structure and a direct bridge back to explicit reasoning tokens.
summary.zh: 把潜在思维限制在词表空间的叠加表示中，为隐空间增加结构并建立返回显式 token 的直接桥梁。

papers.title: Learning When to Stop: Adaptive Latent Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Optimizes a stopping policy for latent reasoning, explicitly trading continuous reasoning length against answer accuracy.
summary.zh: 为潜在推理优化停止策略，显式权衡连续推理长度与答案准确率。

papers.title: Looped ReLU MLPs May Be All You Need as Practical Programmable Computers

summary.en: Shows that a compact looped ReLU MLP can implement the primitive operations of a programmable computer, providing a non-attention comparison point for looped Transformer expressivity.
summary.zh: 证明紧凑的循环 ReLU MLP 可实现可编程计算机的基本操作，为循环 Transformer 的表达能力提供非注意力架构参照。

papers.title: On the Role of Depth and Looping for In-Context Learning with Task Diversity

summary.en: Establishes depth requirements for diverse in-context regression tasks and argues that weight-tied looping retains expressivity while improving robustness and monotonicity across depth.
summary.zh: 建立多样化上下文回归任务的深度需求，并说明权重共享循环在保持表达力的同时，可改善分布偏移鲁棒性和随深度变化的单调性。

papers.title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Hypergraphs with Looped Transformers

summary.en: Extends constructive looped-Transformer simulations from graphs to hypergraphs through graph reductions and hyperedge-aware encodings for algorithms such as Dijkstra and Helly.
summary.zh: 通过图退化与超边感知编码，把循环 Transformer 的构造性算法模拟从图扩展到超图，包括 Dijkstra 与 Helly 等算法。

papers.title: Enhancing Auto-regressive Chain-of-Thought through Loop-Aligned Reasoning

summary.en: RELAY aligns visible reasoning steps with loop iterations, using intermediate supervision to generate length-generalizing rationales that then improve an autoregressive model.
summary.zh: RELAY 将显式推理步骤与循环迭代对齐，通过中间监督生成可进行长度外推的推理链，再用于增强自回归模型。

papers.title: MeSH: Memory-as-State-Highways for Recursive Transformers

summary.en: Adds an explicit memory buffer and lightweight routers to separate long-lived from transient state and encourage distinct computation at different recursive steps.
summary.zh: 引入显式记忆缓冲区和轻量路由器，分离长期与瞬时状态，并促使不同递归步形成差异化计算。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Transformers: Autoregressive Modeling as Iterative Latent Equilibrium

summary.en: Proposes refining each token’s latent state toward a learned energy-based equilibrium before generation, framing autoregressive prediction as a closed-loop correction process.
summary.zh: 在生成每个 token 前，把潜在状态迭代细化到学习到的能量平衡点，将自回归预测重述为闭环纠错过程。

papers.title: Improving Recursive Transformers with Mixture of LoRAs

summary.en: Restores some layer-wise expressivity lost to recursive weight sharing by inserting token-conditioned LoRA experts into a shared feed-forward network.
summary.zh: 在共享前馈网络中加入 token 条件化的 LoRA 专家，补回递归权重共享所损失的部分逐层表达能力。

papers.title: Energy-Entropy Regularization: The True Power of Minimal Looped Transformers

summary.en: Uses Tsallis-entropy and Hamiltonian-inspired optimization to train an unusually small single-head looped Transformer on a long-range induction task.
summary.zh: 利用 Tsallis 熵与受 Hamilton 动力学启发的优化方法，训练极小的单头循环 Transformer 完成长程归纳任务。

papers.title: Loop as a Bridge: Can Looped Transformers Truly Link Representation Space and Natural Language Outputs?

summary.en: Tests whether extra loops improve access to internal knowledge and finds that some apparent bridging gains instead reflect degraded representations, exposing a limit of current looped models.
summary.zh: 检验额外循环能否改善内部知识的表达，发现部分表面增益来自表示退化，从而揭示现有循环模型的内省局限。

papers.title: LoopViT: Scaling Visual ARC with Looped Transformers

summary.en: Builds an 18M-parameter recurrent vision Transformer for ARC-AGI and uses predictive entropy as a parameter-free stopping signal for adaptive visual reasoning depth.
summary.zh: 构建用于 ARC-AGI 的 1800 万参数循环视觉 Transformer，并以预测熵作为无需额外参数的动态停止信号。

papers.title: Step-resolved data attribution for looped transformers

summary.en: Decomposes training-example influence across individual recurrent steps and uses TensorSketch to make per-loop attribution practical without materializing full per-example gradients.
summary.zh: 把训练样本影响分解到各个循环步，并用 TensorSketch 在不显式保存逐样本完整梯度的情况下实现逐步归因。

papers.title: Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models

summary.en: RLTT distributes reinforcement credit across Ouro’s entire latent trajectory instead of rewarding only the final recurrent state, directly training the hidden reasoning process.
summary.zh: RLTT 将强化学习信用分配到 Ouro 的完整潜在轨迹，而不只奖励最后一个循环状态，从而直接训练隐式推理过程。

papers.title: Adaptive Loops and Memory in Transformers: Think Harder or Know More?

summary.en: Combines learned per-layer looping with gated memory banks, separating extra iterative computation from additional learned storage and revealing different benefits across task types.
summary.zh: 结合逐层自适应循环与门控记忆库，将额外迭代计算和额外学习存储分离，并揭示二者在不同任务上的作用差异。

papers.title: LoopRPT: Reinforcement Pre-Training for Looped Language Models

summary.en: Applies reinforcement signals directly to intermediate latent steps during pretraining, aiming to improve hard-token representations earlier in Ouro-style computation.
summary.zh: 在预训练阶段把强化信号直接施加到中间潜在步骤，使 Ouro 式模型更早形成高质量的困难 token 表示。

papers.title: LA-Sign: Looped Transformers with Geometry-aware Alignment for Skeleton-based Sign Language Recognition

summary.en: Uses encoder-decoder recurrence to refine skeletal motion representations and adds geometry-aware cross-modal alignment for isolated sign-language recognition.
summary.zh: 利用编码器—解码器循环细化骨骼动作表示，并加入几何感知的跨模态对齐以完成孤立手语识别。

papers.title: Ouroboros: Dynamic Weight Generation for Recursive Transformers via Input-Conditioned LoRA Modulation

summary.en: Uses a compact controller to generate input- and step-conditioned modulation over shared LoRA bases, giving a recursive block different effective transformations at each visit.
summary.zh: 用紧凑控制器在共享 LoRA 基底上生成输入与步数条件调制，使递归模块每次访问时具有不同的有效变换。

papers.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation

summary.en: Trains recurrent image and video generators with intra-loop self-distillation so one checkpoint supports elastic compute-quality trade-offs at inference.
summary.zh: 用循环内自蒸馏训练图像与视频生成模型，使单一检查点在推理时支持弹性的算力—质量权衡。

papers.title: Relational Preference Encoding in Looped Transformer Internal States

summary.en: Studies preference readout across Ouro iterations; its appended audit retracts inflated headline results but preserves a smaller relational-over-pointwise decoding effect and useful evaluation warnings.
summary.zh: 研究 Ouro 各循环步中的偏好读出；追加审计撤回了被高估的主要结果，但保留了较小的关系式优于逐点式解码效应及重要评估警示。

papers.title: One Step Forward and K Steps Back: Better Reasoning with Denoising Recursion Models

summary.en: Trains recursive reasoners to reverse controlled corruption over multiple refinement steps, providing intermediate-state curricula for search-like structured reasoning.
summary.zh: 训练递归推理器通过多步细化逆转可控扰动，为具有搜索性质的结构化推理提供中间状态课程。

papers.title: Hyperloop Transformers

summary.en: Loops only a middle layer block and adds hyper-connections between visits, targeting strong language modeling under model-memory constraints and quantization.
summary.zh: 只循环中间层块，并在各次访问之间加入 Hyper-Connections，面向模型内存受限与量化场景提升语言建模效率。

papers.title: State Stream Transformer (SST) V2: Parallel Training of Nonlinear Recurrence for Latent Space Reasoning

summary.en: Streams nonlinear recurrent state horizontally across decoder positions and uses a two-pass approximation to train this sequential latent pathway in parallel.
summary.zh: 在解码位置间横向传递非线性循环状态，并用两遍近似实现该顺序潜在通路的并行训练。

papers.title: Latent Chain-of-Thought Improves Structured-Data Transformers

summary.en: Feeds compressed query-position states back as extra tokens for repeated processing, extending latent test-time computation to tabular prediction and time-series forecasting.
summary.zh: 把查询位置的压缩状态作为额外 token 反馈给模型反复处理，将潜在测试时计算扩展到表格预测与时间序列预测。

papers.title: Solve the Loop: Attractor Models for Language and Reasoning

summary.en: Replaces fixed unrolling with an attractor module solved to convergence and trained by implicit differentiation, enabling adaptive effective depth with constant training memory.
summary.zh: 用求解至收敛的吸引子模块取代固定展开，并通过隐式微分训练，实现训练内存恒定的自适应有效深度。

papers.title: LoopQ: Quantization for Recursive Transformers

summary.en: Identifies loop-specific post-training quantization failures and combines scaling, state alignment, and trajectory-aware optimization to limit recursively accumulated error.
summary.zh: 识别循环模型特有的训练后量化失效，并结合激活缩放、状态对齐与轨迹感知优化来抑制递归误差累积。

papers.title: Latent Recurrent Transformer: Architecture Exploration, Training Strategies, and Scaling Behavior

summary.en: Carries a high-level hidden state from one token into the next while preserving the standard KV-cache interface, and introduces interleaved parallel training for the cross-token recurrence.
summary.zh: 把前一 token 的高层隐藏状态传递到下一 token，同时保留标准 KV-cache 接口，并提出交错并行训练处理跨 token 循环。

papers.title: A Dual-Path Architecture for Scaling Compute and Capacity in LLMs

summary.en: Pairs a repeatedly applied deep sublayer with a single-pass wide feed-forward path, allowing token-wise gates to trade iterative compute against one-step parameter capacity.
summary.zh: 将反复执行的深路径与单次执行的宽前馈路径并列，让 token 级门控在迭代计算与单步参数容量间分配资源。

papers.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction

summary.en: Makes progressive multi-view reconstruction explicit by recurrently applying one Transformer block, exposing refinement count as an inference-time compute knob.
summary.zh: 通过循环应用单一 Transformer 块显式实现多视角重建的渐进细化，并把细化次数变成推理时计算旋钮。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers: A Memory-Budget Separation

summary.en: Formalizes a memory-capacity separation: extra iterations do not give compressed latent loops the growing scratchpad available to polynomial-length chain of thought.
summary.zh: 形式化说明记忆容量分离：增加循环次数不会让压缩潜在循环获得多项式长度思维链所拥有的增长式草稿空间。

papers.title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability

summary.en: Cross-attends a recurrent core to frozen context keys and values under a learned stability gate; controlled experiments also document where this recipe fails to beat dense baselines or extrapolate in depth.
summary.zh: 让循环核心在学习式稳定门控下交叉注意固定上下文的键值，并通过受控实验记录该方案未能击败稠密基线或进行深度外推的情形。

papers.title: Test-Time Compute Scaling for ASR with Depth-Conditioned Looped Transformers

summary.en: Turns recurrent encoder depth into an inference budget for speech recognition using sparse CTC checkpoints, depth conditioning, and delayed posterior feedback.
summary.zh: 通过稀疏 CTC 检查点、深度条件调制和延迟后验反馈，把循环编码器深度变成语音识别的推理预算。

papers.title: Rethinking Depth: A study of the Recursive-Transformer for Speech Recognition

summary.en: Systematically studies where and how much recursion to use in speech encoders, finding competitive recognition with substantially fewer unique parameters in limited-loop regimes.
summary.zh: 系统研究语音编码器应在何处、以多大深度递归，发现有限循环可在显著减少独立参数的同时保持有竞争力的识别效果。

papers.title: Demystifying Hidden-State Recurrence: Switchable Latent Reasoning with On-Policy Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Introduces explicit entry and exit tokens around recurrent hidden-state reasoning, making the latent block compatible with on-policy RL and accessible to causal probing.
summary.zh: 在循环隐藏状态推理前后加入显式进入与退出 token，使潜在模块既能使用在策略强化学习，也便于进行因果探测。

papers.title: Learning to Refine Hidden States for Reliable LLM Reasoning

summary.en: Uses learned depth and action controllers to choose how many latent refinements to perform and in which direction before decoding, trained from step-wise likelihood improvement.
summary.zh: 用学习到的深度与动作控制器决定解码前进行多少次潜在细化及其方向，并以逐步似然改善作为训练信号。

papers.title: Repeated Shared Access Enables Grokking, but Edit Propagation Depends on an Addressable Memory

summary.en: Separates recurrence from shared-memory access in a controlled grid, finding that either can enable grokking but reliable multi-hop edit propagation follows addressable memory rather than looping alone.
summary.zh: 在受控实验中分离循环与共享记忆访问：二者都可能促进 grokking，但可靠的多跳编辑传播取决于可寻址记忆，而非循环本身。

papers.title: Dense Supervision Is Not Enough: The Readout Blind Spot in Looped Language Models

summary.en: Shows that per-loop cross-entropy can train usable exits while leaving recurrent-state scale uncontrolled when normalized readouts hide radial information, motivating explicit scale control.
summary.zh: 说明逐循环交叉熵虽能训练可用出口，但归一化读出会遮蔽径向尺度，使循环状态规模失控，因此需要显式尺度约束。

papers.title: DiscoLoop: Looping Discrete Embeddings and Continuous Hidden States for Multi-hop Reasoning

summary.en: Carries both a discrete embedding channel and a continuous hidden-state channel through recurrence, addressing a gap between decodable bridge entities and token-aligned representations.
summary.zh: 在循环中同时传递离散嵌入与连续隐藏状态通道，缓解可解码桥接实体与 token 对齐表示之间的落差。

papers.title: Soft Mixture-of-Recursions: Going Deeper with Recursive Vision Transformers

summary.en: Learns token-wise mixtures over every recursion output so recursive vision Transformers can exploit intermediate states instead of reading only the final visit.
summary.zh: 对所有递归步输出学习 token 级软混合，使递归视觉 Transformer 能利用中间状态，而非只读取最后一次访问。

papers.title: LayerNorm as Implicit Gain Control in Looped Transformers

summary.en: Analyzes pre-LayerNorm as an implicit gain controller for recurrent dynamics, distinguishing spectral stability from operator-norm bounds and stabilization from memory.
summary.zh: 把 Pre-LayerNorm 分析为循环动力学的隐式增益控制器，区分谱稳定性与算子范数界，也区分稳定作用与记忆作用。

papers.title: Per-Token Fixed-Point Convergence in Depth-Recurrent Transformers

summary.en: Measures token-specific convergence depths and shows that a training-free stability rule can halt settled tokens earlier than a learned router at the studied scale.
summary.zh: 测量不同 token 的收敛深度，并显示在所研究规模上，免训练的稳定性规则可比学习式路由器更早停止已收敛 token。

papers.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence

summary.en: Feeds a cached middle-layer representation from the previous token into an earlier layer of the current token, preserving latent computation across decoding steps with localized recurrence.
summary.zh: 把前一 token 的中层表示送入当前 token 的更早层，以局部循环在解码步之间保留潜在计算。

papers.title: Mobius Learning: Cyclic Depth Folding in Transformers

summary.en: Rotates block order across data streams so each shared group learns both shallow and deep roles, exploring cyclic depth folding beyond a fixed loop order.
summary.zh: 在不同数据流间轮换模块顺序，使每个共享模块组同时学习浅层与深层角色，探索超越固定循环顺序的环形深度折叠。

papers.title: Operational Proto-Introspection in Looped Language Models: Process-Quality Taps, Executable Branching, and the Readout-Control Boundary

summary.en: Tests whether Ouro and Huginn states reveal ongoing solution quality, finding useful decision-level readouts while reporting that direct generative steering does not reliably convert.
summary.zh: 检验 Ouro 与 Huginn 状态能否反映当前解题质量，发现其读出可支持决策，但直接生成式操控未能可靠转化为收益。

papers.title: Adaptive Depth in Looped Transformers: Diagnosing Learned Halting Gates and Trajectory Readouts

summary.en: Separates trajectory formation from exit readout and finds that simple post-hoc confidence rules can rival learned gates when the recurrent trajectory is shaped independently.
summary.zh: 区分循环轨迹形成与出口读出，并发现当轨迹独立塑形时，简单的事后置信度规则可与学习式停止门相当。

papers.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers

summary.en: Uses controlled group-word tasks to show how weight tying and training budgets select serial computation frontiers, and introduces convergence-time scaling as a mechanistic diagnostic.
summary.zh: 用受控群字问题研究权重共享与训练预算如何选择串行计算前沿，并提出收敛时间扩展作为机制诊断工具。

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model

summary.en: Pretrains a compact 3B agentic model on a looped Transformer that reuses its layer stack, pairing recurrent depth with a large-scale agentic post-training pipeline.
summary.zh: 基于复用层栈的循环 Transformer 预训练紧凑型 3B Agent 模型，并结合大规模 Agent 后训练流程。

papers.title: Penelope: Localized Latent Recurrence for Efficient Structured Reasoning

summary.en: Restricts recurrent refinement to a middle decoder interval anchored by a cached prefix, reducing the cost of latent reasoning without repeatedly running the full model.
summary.zh: 把循环细化限制在由缓存前缀锚定的解码器中间区间，避免为潜在推理反复执行完整模型。

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution

summary.en: Defines recurrence around a learned input-conditioned anchor whose zero deviation is exactly invariant, removing the forcing bias created by repeated additive input injection.
summary.zh: 围绕学习到的输入条件锚点定义循环，使零偏差严格不变，从而消除重复加性输入注入产生的强迫偏置。

papers.title: bioMoR: Biology-Guided Mixture-of-Recursions for Effective Genomic Learning

summary.en: Injects biological graphs into token embeddings, attention bias, and the recursion router, allocating deeper computation to genes and pathways according to structured knowledge.
summary.zh: 把生物图知识注入 token 嵌入、注意力偏置与递归路由器，依据结构知识为基因和通路分配更深计算。

papers.title: Think Deep, Speak Once: Relit, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework

summary.en: Adds a lightweight recursive latent block to a frozen language model, aiming to combine semantic representations with deep implicit reasoning before a single verbal response.
summary.zh: 在冻结语言模型上加入轻量递归潜在模块，把语义表示与深层隐式推理结合后再一次性输出语言答案。

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning

summary.en: Continuously updates recurrent memory from demonstrations and then solves a query by iterating in a high-dimensional latent space without verbalizing intermediate steps.
summary.zh: 根据示例持续更新循环记忆，再在高维潜在空间中迭代求解查询，而无需语言化中间步骤。

papers.title: MergeOver: Post-Training Token Merging for Recursive Vision Transformers

summary.en: Adds retraining-free token merging to a recursively weight-shared vision Transformer while tracking spatial unmerging constraints across repeated stages.
summary.zh: 在递归权重共享视觉 Transformer 中加入免重训的 token 合并，并跨重复阶段维护空间反合并约束。

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon: Fixing Deployment Bugs and Decreasing Looped Transformer Memory Overhead

summary.en: Audits practical deployment failures of a looped agentic model on Apple Silicon and uses chunked prefill to reduce the peak attention-memory penalty from its second stack pass.
summary.zh: 审计循环 Agent 模型在 Apple Silicon 上的实际部署故障，并用分块预填充降低第二次层栈执行带来的峰值注意力内存开销。

papers.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers

summary.en: Shows that identically trained looped architectures can settle into distinct bifurcation regimes whose relaxation dynamics determine test-time compute scaling.
summary.zh: 说明相同架构与目标的循环模型可能落入不同分岔相，其松弛动力学会决定测试时计算扩展行为。

papers.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers

summary.en: Studies recursive weight sharing when pretraining data are scarce, coupling it with factorized embeddings to spend compute without over-expanding parameter capacity.
summary.zh: 研究预训练数据稀缺时的递归权重共享，并结合因式分解嵌入，在不盲目扩大参数容量的情况下增加计算。

papers.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?

summary.en: Extends Jacobian-lens interventions to virtual unrollings of Ouro and Huginn, finding that both form workspace-like representations but transport and expose them differently across recurrence.
summary.zh: 把 Jacobian Lens 干预扩展到 Ouro 与 Huginn 的虚拟展开，发现二者都形成类似全局工作空间的表示，但跨循环传递与暴露方式不同。

papers.title: RecurTrace: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Loop-Time Memory

summary.en: Lets each repeated layer attend over its own prior loop states and trains a halting head from loss-improvement supervision, combining loop-time memory with input-adaptive depth.
summary.zh: 让每个重复层关注自身此前各循环状态，并用损失改善监督训练停止头，把循环时间记忆与输入自适应深度结合起来。

papers.title: Think Wider: Mitigating Latent Rank Collapse in Implicit Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.en: Identifies latent rank collapse, where successive implicit-CoT states drift toward one dominant direction, and fixes it with a plug-and-play spectral regularizer that penalizes projections onto that direction, raising effective rank without touching the backbone or decoding.
summary.zh: 指出隐式 CoT 中相邻潜在状态会向同一主方向塌缩的潜在秩塌缩现象，并提出即插即用的谱正则项惩罚该方向上的投影，在不改动主干与解码流程的前提下提升有效秩。

papers.title: T-LoopFormer: Token-Level Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers with Dynamic Routing

summary.en: T-LoopFormer lets every token pick its own loop count through a dynamic token-choice router and pairs it with a per-recursion KV cache so tokens at different depths attend only to matching states, lowering decoding latency while holding language-modeling and zero-shot reasoning accuracy.
summary.zh: T-LoopFormer 通过动态 token 选择路由器让每个 token 自行决定循环次数，并为每一轮递归维护独立的 KV 缓存，使不同深度的 token 只访问对应的缓存状态，从而在保持语言建模与零样本推理性能的同时降低解码延迟。

papers.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers

summary.en: Decomposes looped-Transformer update steps with a pathwise curvature decomposition to explain how a locally improving direction can still hurt when applied in full, and finds that a fixed quarter step yields positive reference-utility gains for 72.2-83.2% of selected failures across four settings.
summary.zh: 用路径曲率分解循环 Transformer 的更新步，解释为何局部有利的方向在整步施加时仍会损害参考答案；实验表明固定四分之一步长能在四个设置中 72.2%-83.2% 的选定失败样本上带来参考效用的正向增益。

papers.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

summary.en: LoopSpec drafts tokens from early recurrent states and verifies them at full depth, pipelining future-token drafting with current-token verification and adding a selective second proposal from deeper loops, giving lossless self-speculative decoding without any auxiliary draft model.
summary.zh: LoopSpec 用早期递归状态生成草稿 token，再由完整深度验证，同时把后续 token 的起草与当前 token 的验证流水线化，并可从更深轮次追加第二次提议，从而无需额外草稿模型即可实现无损自推测解码。

papers.title: MoRE: Mixture of Reused Experts

summary.en: Shares expert pools across groups of adjacent layers while keeping a router per layer and adding lightweight depth embeddings, expanding routing combinations without extra parameters and outperforming standard MoE and weight-sharing baselines from 114M to 1.15B.
summary.zh: 在相邻层组之间共享专家池，同时为每层保留独立路由器并加入轻量深度嵌入，在不增加参数的情况下扩大路由组合，在 114M–1.15B 规模上优于标准 MoE 与权重共享基线。

papers.title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents

summary.en: Shows architectural interventions can move scaling exponents, not just constants: model growth with or without weight sharing gives the largest exponent gains, a 7.4B model-growth architecture matches GPT-3 13B on CORE with roughly 20x less compute, and loop count should rise with scale in data-constrained multi-epoch regimes.
summary.zh: 证明架构干预可以改变缩放指数而不只是常数：无论是否共享权重，模型增长都带来最大指数增益，7.4B 的模型增长架构以约少 20 倍计算在 CORE 上匹敌 GPT-3 13B，且在有数据约束的多轮训练情形下循环次数应随规模增加。

papers.title: Storing Is Not Remembering: LSTM-UT and Bounded Gated Memory for Looped Transformers

summary.en: Shows that keeping more history is not the same as making it usable, then adds a small bounded gated cell state to the shared block; trained to depth 12, it holds 99.7% exact accuracy at depth 60 and stays above 99.95% at depth 1,000.
summary.zh: 指出保留更多历史并不等于历史可用，并在共享块中加入小型有界门控单元状态；仅在深度 12 训练，即在深度 60 保持 99.7% 精确精度，深度 1000 时仍高于 99.95%。

papers.title: Prediction Dynamics in Depth-Recurrent Language Models

summary.en: Derives a margin decomposition of why intermediate loop answers already match the final one while their scores keep moving; on Huginn-3.5B and Ouro-1.4B, accounting for update direction and competitor pairing lowers mean earliest qualifying depth by a further 22.5-34.4% of total depth beyond translation removal.
summary.zh: 用间隔分解刻画为何中间循环的答案已与最终答案一致、而分数仍在变化；在Huginn-3.5B与Ouro-1.4B上表明，计入更新方向与竞争者配对后，平均最早合格深度在去除共同平移的基础上再降低总深度的22.5-34.4%。

papers.title: Trading Depth for Time in Recurrent Transformers

summary.en: Inserts a latent thought token between vocabulary tokens so a shared backbone refines the hidden state before predicting. Under matched training FLOPs it beats PonderLM-2 and overtakes a two-loop Transformer as compute rises, recovering 89% of the LRT depth-doubling gain at about half the parameters.
summary.zh: 在相邻词表 token 之间插入一个潜在思考 token，让共享骨干在预测下一个词前精炼隐状态。在训练 FLOPs 匹配的情况下，它优于 PonderLM-2，并随计算量增加超过两循环 Transformer；以约一半参数取得 LRT 深度加倍所带来增益的 89%。

papers.title: When Steering Fails in Latent Reasoning: A Latent-to-Language Transition Gap

summary.en: Finds that steering continuous thoughts transfers far more weakly to the generated answer than steering explicit chain-of-thought, even at comparable representation movement; abrupt output-distribution change at the latent-to-language boundary and weaker bidirectional control support a latent-to-language transition gap.
summary.zh: 发现对连续思考做激活引导时，其对最终生成的影响远弱于对显式思维链的引导，即便表征位移幅度相当；潜空间到语言边界处输出分布的突变以及更弱的双向控制支持“潜在—语言转接鸿沟”的假设。

papers.title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models

summary.en: Wavefront Decoding packs token states from mixed recurrence depths into a single recurrent-block call, arranging them as a diagonal wavefront so shallow-depth drafting and full-depth verification run concurrently and the draft-then-verify phases of self-speculation disappear.
summary.zh: WaveFront 解码把处于不同递归深度的 token 状态压进同一次循环块调用，排成对角波前，使浅层起草与全深度验证并发执行，从而消除自推测解码中“先起草后验证”的阶段划分。

papers.title: Statistical Gains from Looped Estimation under Parameter Budgets

summary.en: Compares looped and untied estimators under a common parameter budget: a squared-Hellinger risk bound for looped sieve MLE and a minimax lower bound for untied families, with looped nets reaching the minimax rate up to log factors for Hölder-smooth targets and untied risk staying positive at sufficiently large fixed budgets.
summary.zh: 在共同参数预算下比较循环与非共享（untied）估计器：给出循环筛极大似然的平方 Hellinger 风险上界与 untied 族的极小极大下界；对已知 Hölder 光滑度的目标，循环网络在对数因子内达到极小极大速率，且在足够大的固定预算下循环风险趋于零，而 untied 风险仍存在正下界。

papers.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing

summary.en: Extends TRM recurrence from 16 to 512 steps on 1,000 hard Sudokus, lifting exact-solve accuracy to 91.9% for the MLP variant, and identifies a shared signature of completed computation: locally contractive motion along the trajectory despite expanding directions elsewhere.
summary.zh: 把 TRM 的循环从 16 步延长到 512 步，在 1000 道困难数独上使 MLP 变体的精确求解率升至 91.9%，并发现计算完成的共同标志：沿轨迹方向局部收缩，而其他方向仍可扩张。

papers.title: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models

summary.en: Attention routing in looped LMs stabilizes well before hidden states do. WISE discovers a block-structured working set with full attention in early loops, then reuses that support while keeping attention weights and recurrent refinement dynamic, reaching 1.76x late-step attention speedup at 4K context.
summary.zh: 循环语言模型的注意力路由比隐状态更早稳定。WISE 在前几轮用完整注意力发现块结构工作集，随后复用该支撑集而保留动态注意力权重与递归精炼，在 4K 上下文下取得 1.76 倍的后期注意力加速。

papers.title: Stream Recursion Model (SRM)

summary.en: Modifies HRM into multiple interacting latent streams updated by recursive refinement so that stream dynamics, causal contribution and routing become directly analyzable, matching GPT-2 per parameter while showing consistent specialization across streams.
summary.zh: 将 HRM 改造为多个相互作用的潜在流并以递归精修更新，使流的动态、因果贡献与路由可直接分析；在单参数效率上匹敌 GPT-2，并显示各流具有稳定的专门化分工。

papers.title: Depth through recurrence: Looped transformers for flow-matching TTS

summary.en: A controlled study of weight reuse in flow-matching TTS: seven loop layouts all execute 18 block calls per evaluation, and applying each of nine blocks twice preserves intelligibility and speaker similarity while using 47.1% fewer parameters than the unshared baseline.
summary.zh: 该工作系统比较流匹配 TTS 中的权重复用布局：七种循环方案每次评估均执行 18 次块调用，其中把九个块各连续执行两次的方案在保持可懂度与说话人相似度的同时，比非共享基线少 47.1% 参数。

papers.title: FlashLoop: Fast and Memory-Efficient Looped Transformers via Lazy Updates

summary.en: Most loop-time work is redundant: state changes concentrate on few tokens, attention-output differences on a sparse stable set of key columns, and inter-loop KV residuals quantize well. FlashLoop exploits these with lazy updates to cut loop FLOPs and KV memory while preserving accuracy.
summary.zh: 循环中的大部分计算是冗余的：状态变化集中在少数 token，注意力输出差异由稀疏而稳定的 key 列主导，相邻轮 KV 残差也易于低比特量化。FlashLoop 据此采用惰性更新，在保持精度的同时降低逐轮算力与 KV 显存。

papers.title: Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Jia Liang, Xi Jin, Liangming Pan

summary.en: Contrasts two looped-Transformer recurrence schemes on polynomial iteration, finite-state composition and graph traversal, finding both generalize past the training horizon yet degrade at greater depth, and that recurrent states encode computational status as well as content.
summary.zh: 从机制上对比两种循环 Transformer 递推方案在多项式迭代、有限状态复合与图遍历任务上的表现，发现二者都能超越训练长度泛化却在更深时退化，且循环状态同时编码内容与“是否仍可继续计算”的状态信息。

papers.title: Next Thoughts Are Distributions: Generative Autoregressive Reasoning in the Latent Space

summary.en: Models each next continuous thought as a multimodal distribution produced by a diffusion head over an autoregressive reasoner, so latent reasoning can branch; ATF improves math accuracy, benefits from reinforcement learning and extra test-time thinking, and covers more solutions across samples.
summary.zh: 用扩散头在自回归推理器上把下一个连续思维建模为多峰分布，使潜在推理可以分支；ATF 提升数学准确率，并能从强化学习与额外测试时思考中获益，多次采样覆盖更多解法。

papers.title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

summary.en: MoR-MLLM brings Mixture-of-Recursions to multimodal LLMs, giving each token a learned recursive depth so visually or linguistically hard tokens get more computation while easy ones skip it, stabilized by three-stage tuning and an entropy-regularized routing loss.
summary.zh: MoR-MLLM 把 Mixture-of-Recursions 引入多模态大模型，为每个 token 学习递归深度，使视觉或语言上困难的 token 获得更多计算、简单 token 跳过冗余操作，并用三阶段调优与熵正则路由损失稳定训练。

papers.title: Loop Dropout: Regularizing Shared Updates in Looped Language Models

summary.en: Identifies a late-loop bias in LoRA on looped LMs, where early loops receive little adaptation, and fixes it with stochastic masking of adapter applications plus inverse-survival rescaling, improving math, instruction tuning, and code at no inference cost.
summary.zh: 发现LoRA用于循环语言模型时存在后循环偏置、前几个循环几乎得不到适配，并用适配器应用的随机掩码加逆生存重标定来修正，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升数学、指令微调与代码表现。

papers.title: Where Do Embodied Decisions Come From? Rethinking Latent and Explicit Reasoning

summary.en: Shows that intervening on explicit CoT collapses VLA navigation F1 from 72.14% to 11.84%, then proposes decide-then-explain, which predicts actions before explanations and beats think-then-act and no-CoT baselines while relying more on perception-grounded latent computation.
summary.zh: 发现干预显式 CoT 会使 VLA 导航 F1 从 72.14% 跌至 11.84%，进而提出先决策后解释的范式：先预测动作再生成解释，在自动驾驶与机器人操作上优于先思考后行动与无 CoT 基线，且更依赖感知驱动的潜在计算。

papers.title: Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization

summary.en: Compares vanilla, CoT, pause-token and two latent-reasoning variants of one backbone on multi-hop reasoning, finding latent models generalize to longer hops because they learn a sparse recurrent search circuit that propagates reachability instead of relying on local graph features.
summary.zh: 在同一主干上比较原始、CoT、停顿 token 与两种潜在推理变体，发现潜在模型能泛化到更多跳数，因为它们学到的是传播可达性的稀疏循环搜索回路，而非依赖局部图特征。

papers.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers

summary.en: TaH2 jointly post-trains a looped backbone and an iteration decider supervised by lookahead labels marking whether another loop helps, concentrating extra iterations on tokens that benefit and raising the AIME accuracy-compute slope by 53% over the non-looped baseline.
summary.zh: TaH2 将循环主干与迭代决策器联合后训练，用前瞻标签标注再做一次循环是否有益，从而把额外迭代集中在真正受益的 token 上，在 AIME 上把精度-计算斜率相对非循环基线提升 53%。

papers.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention

summary.en: Asks how an MoE should be looped and answers with Foil: flatten expert layers so each pass routes over twice as many experts, and untie attention per pass while experts and routers stay shared, lowering loss and balancing routing at 100B tokens.
summary.zh: 研究 MoE 应当如何循环，提出 Foil：压平专家层使每一轮从大一倍的专家池中路由，并让每轮拥有独立注意力参数而专家与路由器保持共享，在 100B token 上降低损失并改善路由均衡。

papers.title: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems

summary.en: Argues that cross-entropy-only training leaves continuous thoughts unconstrained, proves four resulting failure modes, and turns causality, minimality, separability and stability into differentiable auxiliary losses. REST gains up to 7.5 points in single-agent and multi-agent latent recursion.
summary.zh: 指出仅用交叉熵训练会使连续思考缺乏约束，证明由此产生的四种失效模式，并把因果性、最小性、可分离性与稳定性转化为可微辅助损失；REST 在单智能体与多智能体潜在递归中最多提升 7.5 个点。

papers.title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?

summary.en: Controlled study of when extra recurrence helps looped language models: reasoning improves beyond the training horizon while knowledge degrades, effective depth alone does not predict performance, and channel-wise history-state injection with timestep conditioning is more robust than conventional initial-state injection.
summary.zh: 系统研究循环语言模型在何种条件下受益于额外循环：推理表现可在超出训练深度后继续提升，而知识类性能下降；仅凭有效深度不足以预测表现，层与迭代的分配方式同样重要；逐通道历史状态注入配合时间步条件化，比常规初始状态注入更稳健。

papers.title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers

summary.en: TAPS decomposes the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation terms and adapts the step size online; it improves terminal accuracy without retraining and, when folded into training, yields further gains with up to 1.56x wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy.
summary.zh: TAPS 把终端损失对递归更新尺度的敏感性分解为持续进展项与去中心波动项，并在推理时在线调整步长；无需重新训练即可提升终端精度，将该原则写入训练还可再获提升，并在匹配基线精度时实现最高 1.56 倍墙钟加速。

papers.title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers

summary.en: Treats the looped hidden state as fast weights and derives loop transitions in closed form from a projection, a local objective and an optimizer rule; aligning existing transitions' input maps reduces training loss and improves commonsense accuracy, and the derived OperLoop improves generative performance at matched training FLOPs.
summary.zh: 把循环隐状态视为快速权重，从投影、局部目标与优化器规则出发闭式推导循环转移，指出现有转移与之不匹配；对齐现有转移的输入映射后训练损失下降、常识准确率提升，而据此提出的 OperLoop 在匹配训练 FLOPs 下提升了生成性能。

papers.title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Looped Actor is a depth-recurrent policy that refines a latent state toward a fixed point and varies its loop count with the state; it matches an untied baseline with 16x more parameters, and on Boxoban loop counts grow with the number of remaining pushes.
summary.zh: Looped Actor 是一种深度循环策略，用共享块把隐状态迭代推向不动点，并按状态改变循环次数；它以远少参数追平 16 倍参数的非共享基线，且在 Boxoban 上循环次数随剩余推动步数增加。

papers.title: LatentHarness: Learning Latent Actions for Memory and Reasoning via Counterfactual Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Xiaoqiang Wang, Suyuchen Wang, Bang Liu

summary.en: Treats memory access and latent computation as one sequential latent-action policy - THINK, RECALL or EXIT - trained by counterfactual policy distillation that branches each action and scores its effect, improving general and long-context reasoning by 2.8% and 10.0% relative, respectively, while running 5.9x faster.
summary.zh: 把记忆访问与潜在计算统一为 THINK、RECALL、EXIT 三类潜在动作的序列决策，用反事实策略蒸馏对每个动作分支打分训练，在通用与长上下文推理基准上分别相对提升 2.8% 与 10.0%，并快 5.9 倍。

papers.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
papers.authors: Jiaju Wu, Yi Hu, Muhan Zhang

summary.en: Asks whether every loop of a looped Transformer performs the same computation. On graph walks, loops can advance by different numbers of steps, and a learned linear map acting on the entering hidden state selects which learned transition the shared block executes.
summary.zh: 追问循环 Transformer 的每一次循环是否执行相同计算。在图游走任务上，不同循环可前进不同步数，而作用在输入隐状态上的学习到的线性映射 J 会选择共享块执行哪一种已学会的转移。

papers.title: What Limits Recursive Reasoning Models: Optimization, Architecture and Test-Time Scaling

summary.en: Separates architecture, gradient horizon and state-update control across HRM, TRM and URM in one pipeline and finds an explicit hierarchy is unnecessary: a stable 13.6M model with an intermediate gradient horizon and large batches lifts Arithmetic OOD accuracy from 36.2% to 71.2%.
summary.zh: 在同一实验流程中分离 HRM、TRM 与 URM 的架构、梯度视野与状态更新控制，发现显式层级结构并非必需：采用中等梯度视野与大物理批次的稳定 13.6M 模型把算术分布外准确率从 36.2% 提升到 71.2%。

papers.title: Looped Diffusion Transformer

summary.en: Looped-DiT repeats shared Transformer blocks inside each denoising step and stabilizes the extra depth with deep supervision across loops plus self-modulating attention. A 260M looped model surpasses a 6.5x larger baseline while using 4.9x less inference compute.
summary.zh: Looped-DiT 在每个去噪步内重复执行共享 Transformer 块，并用跨轮深监督与自调制注意力稳定额外深度；260M 参数的循环模型超过大 6.5 倍的基线，推理算力低 4.9 倍。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Yanbei Chen, Anirudh Goyal, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi

summary.en: Derives a joint scaling law over model size, data, sparsity and loop count through a bounded sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping, finding that sparsity buys roughly 3x active-parameter efficiency while recurrence buys roughly 2x total-parameter efficiency on reasoning.
summary.zh: 通过有界的稀疏条件循环映射，把模型规模、数据、稀疏度与循环次数纳入统一缩放律，发现稀疏度带来约 3 倍激活参数效率，而循环在推理任务上带来约 2 倍总参数效率。

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models

summary.en: Cuts from-scratch looped-LM training from 7.7T to 310B tokens with mid-training, warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization; a 1.4B looped model beats a parameter-matched dense baseline on all 12 benchmarks, and a single learned input-mixing scalar plus a smoothed exit loss converts a pretrained dense checkpoint.
summary.zh: 通过中期训练、学习率预热与更强的退出门正则，把循环语言模型的从零训练成本从7.7T降到310B token；1.4B循环模型在全部12项基准上胜过参数匹配的稠密基线，而仅用一个可学习输入混合标量加平滑退出损失，即可把预训练稠密模型转为循环模型。

papers.title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts

summary.en: Diagnoses why looped MoE stops paying off past two passes - residual variance growth and expert-selection collapse - then stabilizes recurrence with scaled residual updates, input re-injection, per-loop routers and a looping residual to reach 9-12 stable loops from 100M to 1.7B.
summary.zh: 诊断循环 MoE 在两轮之后收益消失的原因——残差方差随迭代增长与专家选择塌缩，再用残差缩放、输入重注入、逐循环路由器与循环残差加以稳定，在 100M–1.7B 规模上稳定循环 9–12 轮。

papers.title: Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks

summary.en: Asks how much a depth-only, heavily weight-tied attention stack can represent and proves that two frozen single-head residual softmax blocks with Gaussian-initialized projections can interpolate any collection of N token sequences of length n to any other such collection at continuous or finite depth, while characterizing the restrictions imposed by causal masking.
summary.zh: 研究仅靠深度、高度权重共享的自注意力堆叠能表示多少函数，证明两个冻结的单头 softmax 残差块（高斯初始化投影）可在连续或有限深度下，把任意 N 条长度为 n 的 token 序列集合插值到另一同规模集合，并刻画因果掩码带来的限制及相应保证。

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers

summary.en: Pretrains looped LMs so only the first recursion writes a KV cache while later recursions read it plus a short local window; sharing memory improves quality instead of costing it, cutting context memory 76-79% at five recursions from 150M to 1B.
summary.zh: 预训练时只让第一轮循环写入 KV 缓存，后续循环读取该缓存并保留一小段本地窗口；共享记忆不但没有损害质量反而提升质量，在 150M–1B 规模、五轮循环下将上下文内存降低 76%–79%。

papers.title: On the Chain-of-Thought Monitorability of Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Han Wang, Ishwar B Balappanawar, Huan Zhang

summary.en: First systematic evaluation of chain-of-thought monitorability in looped language models: across eight MonitorBench tasks in standard and stress-test settings, deeper loops reduce monitoring only on specific Logic/Science/Engineering cue-answer tasks, and looped models are not systematically less monitorable than size- or depth-matched non-looped ones.
summary.zh: 首次系统评估循环语言模型的思维链可监控性：在 MonitorBench 八个任务的标准与压力测试设置下，更深的循环只在特定的逻辑、科学、工程类线索—答案任务上削弱监控；与参数量或深度匹配的非循环模型相比，循环模型并未系统性更难监控。

papers.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models

summary.en: ALoDLM replaces the uniform denoising depth of diffusion language models with token-adaptive latent recurrence: ready positions commit early while unresolved ones keep refining, and a token-wise schedule learned through a conditional NELBO improves quality-efficiency at 1.7B and 8B.
summary.zh: ALoDLM 用 token 自适应的潜在递归取代扩散语言模型中统一的去噪深度：已经可以确定的位置提前提交，未解决的位置继续精炼，并通过条件 NELBO 学习 token 级计算调度，在 1.7B 与 8B 规模上改善质量-效率权衡。

papers.title: AdaLoop: Adaptive-Depth Latent Reasoning for Audio Language Models

summary.en: AdaLoop adds a lightweight recurrent module that iterates a shared Transformer block over an audio representation and learns when to halt per audio-question pair, adding under 3% parameters and improving three audio LLMs by 2.9 to 3.8 points, with the largest gains on perception-heavy subtasks.
summary.zh: AdaLoop 增加一个轻量循环模块，用共享 Transformer 块反复精炼音频表示，并为每个音频-问题对学习何时停止，参数量增加不足 3%，在三个音频大模型上平均提升 2.9 至 3.8 分，最大增益出现在感知密集型子任务上。

papers.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
papers.authors: Yassine Ouali, Adrian Bulat, Georgios Tzimiropoulos

summary.en: Derives FLaRe from five requirements for a latent thought (useful, diverse, explainable, refinable, efficient): a flow-matching recipe covering what the latent encodes, where to train the flow and how to read out, reaching 97% of explicit-CoT accuracy at a quarter of the latency.
summary.zh: 从潜在思考应满足的五项要求（有用、多样、可解释、可精炼、高效）出发提出 FLaRe：一套流匹配训练配方，涵盖潜在空间编码什么、在何处训练流以及如何读出答案，以四分之一延迟达到显式 CoT 97% 的准确率。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points

summary.en: Argues that near-fixed-point recurrent states license truncated backprop, terminal KV sharing, faster distilled prefill, and replay-based RL, then improves the two ingredients shaping those fixed points: a learned entropy-regularized depth prior and orthogonal input injection.
summary.zh: 指出接近不动点的循环状态可支撑截断反传、末端KV共享、更快的蒸馏预填充与基于回放的强化学习，并改进塑造这些不动点的两个训练要素：带熵正则的可学习深度先验与正交输入注入。

papers.title: Recurrent Looped Transformer

summary.en: Splits layers into a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder that merges each token's encoder output with the previous token's decoder state, so computation depth grows with sequence length at fixed per-token cost and parity generalizes to 256 bits.
summary.zh: 把层拆分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器，解码器将当前 token 的编码输出与上一 token 的解码状态合并，使计算深度随序列长度增长而单 token 成本固定，奇偶校验可泛化到 256 位。

papers.title: Continuous Memory Machines

summary.en: Splits recurrent state into matrix-valued short- and long-term memories with distinct roles, jointly read and written by a Transformer, improving generalization over memory-augmented baselines on algorithmic, in-context and recurrent reasoning while keeping the Continuous Thought Machine's interpretable attention.
summary.zh: 把循环状态拆分为承担不同角色的矩阵值短期与长期记忆，由 Transformer 联合读写，在算法、上下文学习与循环推理任务上优于既有记忆增强网络，同时保留连续思维机可解释的注意力模式。

papers.title: Enabling Dynamic Computation in Looped LMs

summary.en: Ouro-style looped LMs do not realize dynamic computation in practice because every loop needs its own KV cache; a best-available KV caching scheme cuts FLOPs and KV memory by up to 30% at full-depth performance, and a corrected early-exit prior lets tokens exit at heterogeneous depths.
summary.zh: 作者指出 Ouro 式循环语言模型因每一轮循环都需要独立 KV 缓存，在实践中并未真正实现动态计算；“最佳可用”KV 缓存策略在保持全深度性能的同时把 FLOPs 与 KV 内存最多减少 30%，修正后的早退先验则让 token 按难度在不同深度退出。

papers.title: Think Before You Paint: Recursive Latent Reasoning for Diffusion Models

summary.en: Places a small TRM-style Thinker inside every denoising step of a frozen diffusion model, reasoning over learned tokens and steering generation through ControlNet, which solves 92.5% of hard MNIST Sudoku with 10M parameters and no symbolic supervision.
summary.zh: 在冻结扩散模型的每个去噪步内嵌入小型 TRM 式 Thinker，在学到的 token 网格上推理并通过 ControlNet 引导生成，仅用 10M 参数、无需符号监督即解出 92.5% 的困难 MNIST 数独。

papers.title: ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals

summary.en: KV states in looped Transformers repeat across loops. ResidualQuant stores the final loop at higher precision and encodes earlier loops as INT2 residuals with least-squares scaling and rotations, plus loop-wise mixed precision, cutting KV storage 80.7% while keeping accuracy near BF16.
summary.zh: 循环 Transformer 各轮的 KV 状态高度相似。ResidualQuant 以最后一轮 KV 为高精度参考，把前面各轮编码为带最小二乘缩放与旋转的 INT2 残差，并配合逐轮混合精度，将 KV 存储压缩 80.7%，精度仍接近 BF16。

papers.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models

summary.en: Uses a looped model's own frozen terminal loop as a compute-privileged teacher for its intermediate loops on student-generated rollouts, giving dense cross-loop supervision without external teachers; a dynamic variant refreshes the teacher as shared weights update.
summary.zh: 把循环模型自身冻结的末端循环当作算力更强的教师，在学生自生成的轨迹上指导中间循环，无需外部教师即可获得跨循环的稠密监督；动态版本随共享权重更新持续刷新教师。

papers.title: Safe at One Loop, Risky at Another: Aligning Safety Across Recurrent Depths in Looped Language Models

summary.en: Shows that one looped LM can be safe at one inference depth and jailbreakable at another, with attacks transferring across depths; proposes SafeBridge, which adds depth-specific control and selective state bridging over shared recurrent layers with joint safety supervision across depths.
summary.zh: 揭示同一循环语言模型在不同推理深度上可能一边安全、一边可被越狱，且攻击可跨深度迁移；提出 SafeBridge，在共享循环层上加入深度特定控制与选择性状态桥接，并跨深度联合施加安全监督。

papers.title: Invariant-Measure Reasoners: Stable Representations for Latent Reasoning
papers.authors: Yuto Inui, Takuya Konishi, Yoshinobu Kawahara

summary.en: Observes that recurrently updated latents can settle on a compact set without reaching a fixed point, and predicts from the invariant measure over that set, stabilising answers across depths and sometimes exploiting non-fixed-point dynamics rather than suppressing them.
summary.zh: 注意到反复更新的隐状态可能收敛到一个紧集却不收敛到不动点，于是用该集合上的不变测度做预测，使不同循环深度下的答案更稳定，并在某些情形下反而利用了这种非不动点动力学。

papers.title: From Chain-of-Thought to Loops: Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers

summary.en: Replaces left-to-right latent generation with iterative refinement of a compact latent workspace: a shared Transformer is reapplied several times, a probabilistic head samples latent tokens in parallel, and those condition an autoregressive decoder. Matches explicit-CoT accuracy on HumanEval and MBPP at 42x lower reasoning-phase latency.
summary.zh: 用对紧凑潜在工作区的迭代精炼取代从左到右的潜在生成：共享 Transformer 反复应用若干次后，由概率头并行采样潜在 token 来条件化自回归解码器；在 HumanEval 与 MBPP 上准确率与显式 CoT 相当，而推理阶段延迟降至约 1/42。

papers.title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals

summary.en: Argues looped Transformers need loop-native residuals: content-weighted, temporally decayed aggregation of past recurrent states suppresses unreliable updates and lets a 7M model keep improving beyond 20,000 test-time iterations on Sudoku-Extreme.
summary.zh: 主张循环 Transformer 需要专属的循环原生残差：以内容加权与时间衰减聚合历史循环状态，抑制不可靠更新，使 7M 参数模型在数独极限版上超过两万次测试时迭代仍持续提升。

papers.title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts
papers.authors: Adrian Bulat, Yassine Ouali, Georgios Tzimiropoulos

summary.en: Applies a single ViT block repeatedly and restores depth-specific FFNs through a continuous depth coordinate that mixes a small shared expert bank, matching full-depth encoders with about 70% fewer stored parameters and supporting resampled elastic deployment depths.
summary.zh: 反复应用单个 ViT 块，并用连续深度坐标混合一个小型共享专家库来恢复各循环深度特有的 FFN，以约少 70% 的存储参数达到全深度编码器精度，并支持重采样的弹性部署深度。

papers.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models

summary.en: Elastic Latent Recurrence trains looped LMs so one checkpoint reaches near-parity with a non-recurrent model at a single loop and gains accuracy with each extra loop, using gated state updates, mixed loop counts, and loop-index/budget conditioning; the 4B model adds 7.25 points at four loops.
summary.zh: Elastic Latent Recurrence 训练出的循环语言模型在单循环时即可接近同规模非循环模型的精度，并随循环次数增加持续提升；其关键在于门控状态更新、混合循环数训练以及按循环序号与预算进行条件化，4B 模型四循环时提升 7.25 分。

papers.title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models

summary.en: Quantization error injected early in a recurrent trajectory is attenuated by later loops, so RAMP runs early refinement in low-precision weight-activation arithmetic and restores full precision for terminal loops, keeping prefill quality with up to 1.16x first-prefill speedup at 4K context.
summary.zh: 递归早期注入的量化误差会被后续轮次逐步衰减。RAMP 因此让前段递归使用低精度权重-激活计算，仅在末端若干轮恢复高精度，在 4K 上下文下保持预填充质量并获得最高 1.16 倍的首次预填充加速。

papers.title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement

summary.en: Eco-RNA is an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model whose shared, input-conditioned Transformer core is applied repeatedly, making inference depth a post-training knob; increasing refinement from one to four iterations improves RNAGym fitness prediction at fixed parameters.
summary.zh: Eco-RNA 是 80M 参数的 RNA 基础模型，其共享的输入条件 Transformer 核心被反复应用，使推理深度成为训练后可调的旋钮；在参数固定时，把精炼轮次从 1 增加到 4 可提升 RNAGym 适应度预测。

papers.title: Adaptive-Depth Is a Finishing Stage

summary.en: Fixed-first training holds a fixed shallow depth for most of the run and varies depth only in a short final phase, cutting modeled training compute by 45% at 200M and 31-37% at 1B parameters while keeping NLL within 0.5% and 0.8% respectively.
summary.zh: 固定优先训练在大部分训练中保持较浅的固定深度，只在最后阶段改变深度；在2亿参数下把建模训练算力降低45%、在10亿参数下降低31-37%，NLL分别控制在0.5%与0.8%以内。

papers.title: Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers

summary.en: Analyses depth extrapolation on all-pairs graph connectivity and shows that, under exchangeability and symmetric positive initialization, population training at depth K converges to an update rule governed by a single propagation-versus-fitting parameter, yielding a finite window of safe test depths with explicit endpoints and a certified depth gain that grows exponentially as training depth outpaces training hardness.
summary.zh: 以全对连通性任务分析深度外推，证明在可交换性与对称正初始化条件下，深度 K 上的总体训练（population training）收敛为由单一参数控制的更新规则，该参数在传播与拟合之间权衡，由此得到端点显式的有限安全测试深度窗口；当训练深度超出训练难度越多，认证的深度增益呈指数增长。

papers.title: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models

summary.en: Across four Ouro checkpoints and Huginn, cutting loop counts degrades safety far more than accuracy, with harmful-help rate rising 5.3x at half depth; existing early-exit rules do not spend extra loops on harmful requests, whereas training at randomized depths repairs the gap.
summary.zh: 作者在四个 Ouro 检查点与 Huginn 上减少循环次数，发现安全性下降远大于精度损失——半深度时有害请求获得帮助的比例上升 5.3 倍；现有早退规则不会为有害请求分配更多循环，而随机深度训练能修复这一缺口。

papers.title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers

summary.en: LoopQuant canonicalizes activations across recurrent states, allocates per-loop activation precision under a fixed bit budget, and calibrates in task space so quantized inference follows the low-bit recurrent trajectory; on Ouro-2.6B its W4A4 setting outperforms all W4A8 baselines.
summary.zh: LoopQuant 统一跨轮递归状态的激活分布，在固定比特预算下按轮次敏感度分配激活精度，并在任务空间校准，使量化推理贴合低比特递归轨迹；在 Ouro-2.6B 上其 W4A4 配置超过所有 W4A8 基线。

papers.title: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers

summary.en: Supervises a recurrent diffusion Transformer's shared block with a pretrained visual encoder's representation, so extra inference visits extrapolate beyond training depth, cutting a SiT-B/2 local-REG baseline's FID from 15.08 to 4.91, with a third visit improving a two-visit checkpoint from 14.71 to 5.34.
summary.zh: 用预训练视觉编码器的表征监督循环扩散 Transformer 的共享块，使额外推理轮次能外推到训练深度之外：将 SiT-B/2 的局部 REG 基线 FID 从 15.08 降至 4.91，第三次访问则把两轮检查点的 FID 从 14.71 改善到 5.34。

papers.title: Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models

summary.en: Builds a five-lens mechanistic inspection protocol and applies it to eight looped language models from four families, separating carry loops (Ouro, LoopUS), which pass the prompt only inside the looped state, from re-read loops (Parcae, Huginn, Rec-OLMo), which re-supply it at every iteration.
summary.zh: 提出包含五个视角的机制可解释性检查流程，并应用于四个家族的八个循环语言模型，区分“携带式循环”（Ouro、LoopUS，提示仅随循环状态传递）与“重读式循环”（Parcae、Huginn、Rec-OLMo，每次迭代重新注入提示）。

papers.title: Looped Reasoning Finishes Earlier Than You Think

summary.en: Shows that slowly decaying oscillatory modes can impose their convergence rate on coupled latent dynamics, then introduces QRR, a gauge-equivariant recurrent reasoner with exact per-token phase-rotation symmetry that avoids forming a dominant slow oscillatory bottleneck while leaving reasoning-relevant quotient dynamics decoupled, converging faster on Sudoku, Maze and Mini-ARC.
summary.zh: 指出缓慢衰减的振荡模态可能主导耦合隐动力学的收敛速率，进而提出具有精确逐 token 相位旋转对称性的规范等变循环推理器 QRR；该设计不再形成主导性的慢振荡瓶颈，同时保持推理相关商动力学解耦，在 Sudoku、Maze 与 Mini-ARC 上收敛更快。

papers.title: Tiny Recursive Message Passing

summary.en: Ports the TRM recipe - deep supervision, truncated recursions and test-time deduction - onto message passing networks, reaching about 99% on Sudoku-Extreme with a 16k-parameter model trained in ten minutes and transferring zero-shot to larger N-queens and SAT instances.
summary.zh: 把 TRM 的深监督、截断递归与测试时演绎流程移植到消息传递网络，仅用 16k 参数、十分钟训练的模型即在数独极限版上达到约 99%，并零样本迁移到更大规模的 N 皇后与 SAT 实例。

papers.title: Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers

summary.en: Separates failed computation, lost retention, and non-reusable states in looped Transformers using in-context Mealy machines with exact hidden-state counterfactuals: models trained to answer at loop 32 keep only 22% of those answers at loop 64, while random-position supervision keeps 99.8%.
summary.zh: 用带有精确隐状态反事实的上下文 Mealy 机，把循环 Transformer 的失败拆分为计算失败、保持丢失与状态不可复用：训练在 32 次循环作答的模型到 64 次循环只剩 22% 的答案，而随机位置监督可保留 99.8%。

papers.title: Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning
