summary.en: Across 21 model-task configurations, combines chain deletion, content replacement, probing and trajectory analysis to show that on logical tasks COCONUT often carries an answer readable before the chain begins, and proposes a taxonomy separating what a latent chain represents from how the model uses it.
summary.zh: 在 21 组模型-任务配置中结合链删除、内容替换、探针与轨迹分析，发现在逻辑任务上 COCONUT 往往在链开始前就已编码可读答案，并提出区分潜在链所表示的内容与模型实际使用方式的统一分类法。

papers.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models

summary.en: LoopAhead adds a lightweight lookahead drafter that predicts several future tokens from early-loop states, lets deeper loops decide which speculative branches to continue or pause, and keeps the full-depth model as final arbiter, reaching up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding.
summary.zh: LoopAhead 引入轻量前瞻起草器，利用早期循环状态一次预测多个未来 token，再由更深轮次决定哪些推测分支继续或暂停，最终由全深度模型裁决，相对自回归解码最高取得 7.82 倍加速。

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones
papers.authors: Madhav Iyengar, Andreas Geiger, Hilde Kühne

summary.en: The authors prune layers from a pretrained VLM's language backbone, loop over a subset of survivors with a linear adapter that fuses preceding-layer tokens, and recover quality through language-only pretraining, projector alignment and visual instruction tuning, outperforming the unpruned baseline with 23.3% fewer language parameters.
summary.zh: 作者裁剪预训练 VLM 语言骨干的层数，用融合前层 token 的线性适配器循环剩余层中的一部分，并通过纯语言预训练、投影器对齐与视觉指令微调恢复性能，在语言参数减少 23.3% 的同时超过未剪枝基线。

papers.title: Causal Latent Workspaces for Looped Transformers

summary.en: Adds a causal, content-addressable prefix workspace to an anchored four-round shared-depth Transformer: each position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and retrieves a summary before the next block application, achieving the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings against five Transformer controls.
summary.zh: 在锚定的四轮共享深度循环 Transformer 中加入因果、按内容寻址的前缀工作区：每个位置把门控向量写入前缀专属的潜在槽位，并在下一次共享块运算前取回摘要；在六种设置中的五种取得最优平均留出困惑度，优于五个 Transformer 对照组。

papers.title: Sep-Latent: Separator Tokens as Natural Compression Anchors for Implicit Reasoning

summary.en: Uses separator tokens as structural anchors with an attention-decay mechanism and multi-level distillation so latent reasoning can terminate adaptively by query difficulty, reaching 56.8% on GSM8k-Aug with only 5.4 latent tokens on average.
summary.zh: 以分隔符 token 作为结构锚点，配合注意力衰减与多层蒸馏，使潜在推理可按问题难度自适应终止，在 GSM8k-Aug 上平均仅用 5.4 个潜在 token 即达到 56.8% 准确率。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

summary.en: Isolates three design axes of looped LMs - where recurrence sits, how inputs are injected, and how recurrent state is organized - and finds the complete Huginn-style design, built on a prelude-recurrent block-coda sandwich, beats Ouro at 730M and transfers to MoE at 8B-A0.8B (32B-A3B unrolled).
summary.zh: 系统拆解循环语言模型的三个设计轴——循环位于何处、输入如何注入、循环状态如何组织，发现以 prelude-recurrent block-coda 夹层为核心的完整 Huginn 式设计在 730M 规模上优于 Ouro，并可迁移到 8B-A0.8B（展开后 32B-A3B）的 MoE 模型。

papers.title: Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks

summary.en: On directed permutation traversal with per-hop ground truth, a four-layer block iterated eight times solves every seed, whereas an identically trained untied model of equal effective depth fails unless given a lower learning rate or intermediate-layer supervision; probing and interventions show an iteration-budget-aware staircase.
summary.zh: 在有逐跳真值的有向置换遍历任务上，四层块迭代八次可在所有随机种子下解出，而同等有效深度、同样训练的非绑定模型除非降低学习率或监督其中间层，否则始终做不到；探针与干预显示循环模型形成随迭代预算调整的逐步推进阶梯。

papers.title: Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing

summary.en: Shows that sharing granularity is a key factor alongside sharing amount: partitioning layers into contiguous blocks that are each reused before advancing balances local refinement against depth-wise differentiation, beating layer-wise and whole-stack recursive sharing up to 1.7B parameters.
summary.zh: 指出共享粒度是与共享比例并列的关键因素：将层划分为连续块并逐块递归复用，在局部精修与深度差异化之间取得平衡，在 1.7B 参数以内优于逐层共享与整栈循环复用。

papers.title: UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop

summary.en: Upcycles a pretrained LLM into a looped one by recurring each selected layer locally and adding hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, breaking the two-loop saturation of prior looped models and gaining 6.17 points across 20 benchmarks at three loops.
summary.zh: 通过逐层局部循环，并在注意力与 MLP 残差分支上加入隐维门控，把预训练 LLM 升级为循环模型，突破以往两轮即饱和的限制，三轮时在 20 个基准上平均提升 6.17 个百分点。

papers.title: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models

summary.en: Removes the serial dependency between loop iterations by splitting computation into a latent slot and a prediction slot, so the current token consumes the previous token's deep state and paired invocations replace sequential ones, retaining 93.1-96.5% (dense) and 98.1-99.6% (MoE) of vanilla decoding throughput.
summary.zh: 将循环迭代拆分为潜在槽与预测槽，使当前 token 复用上一 token 的深层状态，用成对调用取代串行调用，在保持自回归生成的同时保留原始解码吞吐：稠密模型 93.1%–96.5%，MoE 模型 98.1%–99.6%。

papers.title: Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit

summary.en: Fine-tunes on progressively larger vocabularies and lookaheads, letting Qwen3-0.6B reach 98% accuracy at lookahead 256 versus 45% without curriculum, but progress follows a saturating exponential implying a finite intrinsic implicit-reasoning depth that grows with model size.
summary.zh: 通过逐步增大词表与前瞻步数的课程微调，使 Qwen3-0.6B 在前瞻 256 步时达到 98%（无课程仅 45%），但进步呈饱和指数趋势，说明隐式推理深度存在随模型规模增长的内在上限。

papers.title: Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere

summary.en: SFPRM moves the damped fixed-point loop of FPRM onto the unit hypersphere, turning input injection, damping, and halting into geodesic operations that are bounded by construction; it beats FPRM on Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and Mini-ARC while allocating test-time compute more effectively.
summary.zh: SFPRM 把 FPRM 的阻尼不动点循环搬到单位超球面上，使输入注入、阻尼与停机都成为测地线操作并天然有界；在 Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard 与 Mini-ARC 上优于 FPRM，且测试时计算分配更有效。

papers.title: Internalizing Chain-of-thought into Looped Transformers

summary.en: Constructs constant-bit-size looped Transformers that interpolate between explicit chain-of-thought and latent thought, proving that L loops cut a time-t, space-s Turing-machine simulation's context and emitted-token counts by a factor of L (given s(n)^{1/k}=Ω(L)) relative to the unlooped queue-machine baseline.
summary.zh: 构造常位宽循环 Transformer，可在显式思维链与隐式思考之间插值；证明在 s(n)^{1/k}=Ω(L) 的条件下，用 L 次循环模拟时间 t、空间 s 的图灵机时，相对非循环队列机基线，上下文窗口与生成 token 数均缩小约 L 倍。

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation

summary.en: Varies model size, tokens, and forward/backward loop counts across nearly 600 runs and fits one scaling law in effective parameters; at matched compute, full BPTT through fewer loops beats truncated training, and two trained loops is the best looped setting.
summary.zh: 在近600次训练中联合改变模型规模、token预算与前向/反向循环数，并用有效参数拟合统一的缩放律；等算力下，用更少循环做完整BPTT优于截断训练，训练两个循环是循环模型的最优设置。

papers.title: Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM

summary.en: Tests whether nesting a persistent intermediate state inside HRM, TRM and URM, so repeated fast-state updates are integrated through the same operator, helps on ARC-AGI-1; at matched parameters and a single-GPU budget it finds no consistent advantage and specifies a confirmatory protocol.
summary.zh: 在 HRM、TRM 与 URM 中加入持久的中间状态，使快速状态的反复更新经同一算子整合，检验嵌套递归能否提升 ARC-AGI-1 表现；在参数匹配且单卡预算下未发现一致优势，并给出后续确证实验方案。

papers.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models

summary.en: recAMPLIFY pretrains a weight-tied protein language model whose core refines residues over an adjustable number of cycles, then adds Gated Mixture Recurrence, a learned residual gate unifying halting and gating that cuts expected layer depth by up to 37% while halt depth tracks biological properties.
summary.zh: recAMPLIFY 预训练一个权重共享的蛋白质语言模型，其核心以可变循环次数精炼残基表示，并提出 Gated Mixture Recurrence：用学习到的残差门把停机与门控统一为单一自适应计算目标，使期望层深最多降低 37%，且停机深度与生物学性质相关。

papers.title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing

summary.en: Jointly fine-tuning Ouro-1.4B-Thinking, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, HRM-Text-1B and Qwen3 baselines on nine clinical datasets, the authors evaluate on four held-out sets (13 total): Ouro-1.4B-Thinking beats Qwen3-1.7B on 11 datasets, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking is competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks, and HRM-Text-1B is mixed, with the largest gains on inference and question answering.
summary.zh: 作者在 9 个临床数据集上联合微调 Ouro-1.4B/2.6B-Thinking、HRM-Text-1B 与 Qwen3 基线，并在 4 个留出集（共 13 个数据集）上评估：Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 在 11 个数据集上优于 Qwen3-1.7B，Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 在多数任务上可与 Qwen3-8B 匹敌，HRM-Text-1B 表现不一，推理与问答类任务提升最大。

papers.title: HistoLoop: Iterative Contextual Inference with a Looped Transformer for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction

summary.en: HistoLoop casts spatial gene-expression prediction as iterative contextual inference: a shared spatial Transformer aggregates spot states into multi-resolution context tokens, cross-attention retrieves spot-specific context, and a memory-mediated update carries state to the next resolution, giving the highest macro-average under HEST-Bench HVG50.
summary.zh: HistoLoop 把空间基因表达预测建模为迭代上下文推断：共享空间 Transformer 将 spot 状态聚合为多分辨率上下文 token，交叉注意力检索 spot 专属上下文，再经记忆介导的更新把状态带到下一分辨率，在 HEST-Bench HVG50 上领先。

papers.title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder

summary.en: Separates context construction from state refinement: a single-pass encoder writes global KV caches that stay fixed while a weight-tied recurrent decoder attends to them jointly with its own local KV, improving perplexity and zero-shot accuracy up to 1B.
summary.zh: 将上下文构建与状态精修分离：单遍编码器写出固定的全局 KV 缓存，权重共享的循环解码器在同一次 softmax 中同时关注全局 KV 与自身局部 KV，在 1B 规模上改善困惑度与零样本准确率。

papers.title: Present but Hard to Read: Probing Latent Reasoning with Minimal Pairs

summary.en: Minimal-pair probing of Ouro-1.4B and Qwen 2.5-1.5B finds a copied digit in a code shared across questions (readout about 0.9), while a one-prompt-at-a-time probe barely reads it; a small signal for the unwritten intermediate sum is readable but not used.
summary.zh: 对 Ouro-1.4B 与 Qwen 2.5-1.5B 做最小对比探测：被复制的数字存在于跨问题共享的编码中（读出值约 0.9），而一次只看一个提示的探针几乎读不出；未写出的中间和虽有微弱信号且可读，却并未真正被使用。

papers.title: Predictive Latents for Autoregressive Language Models: Possibility, Gauge, and Obstruction

summary.en: Separates token, teacher-forced and open-loop risks for iterated latents, showing that under a full-rank-covariance statistic, a linear least-squares transition and a refit unembedding a width-k latent matches the Bayes token predictor up to an invertible gauge, and that small one-step losses do not certify token prediction or free rollout unless a rank/injectivity condition is stated.
summary.zh: 把迭代隐状态的风险拆成 token 风险、教师强制风险与开环风险；在满秩协方差统计量、线性最小二乘转移与重新拟合的 unembedding 条件下，宽度 k 的隐状态可在可逆规范变换意义下匹配贝叶斯预测器，而单步损失很小并不能证明 token 预测或自由展开可靠，除非同时给出秩或单射条件。

papers.title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?

summary.en: Measures, exactly and for every truncation length from one backward pass, the weight gradient discarded by last-k-loop training on nine looped language models: it sits near the output, shrinks during fine-tuning, and shows no demonstrated advantage over simple rules in predicting truncation's training cost.
summary.zh: 在九个循环语言模型上，用一次反向传播精确算出每种截断长度所丢弃的权重梯度：该梯度集中在输出端、在微调过程中变小，且未能证明比无需测量的简单规则更能预测截断的训练代价。

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models

summary.en: Adds selective looping inside each denoising step of uniform diffusion language models, cutting training FLOPs by up to 3.3x at matched validation NLL and lowering generation perplexity at a fixed denoising budget, with loop-count distributions favoring smaller counts.
summary.zh: 在均匀扩散语言模型的每个去噪步内加入选择性循环，在相同验证 NLL 下最多减少 3.3 倍训练算力，并在固定去噪步数下降低生成困惑度；训练时偏向较小循环次数的分布更高效。

papers.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation

summary.en: LoopRec applies one weight-shared block recurrently in sequential recommendation and puts a lightweight binary exit-or-continue gate at each recursion boundary, turning fixed depth into a per-item property; learned allocation sends deeper computation to lower-frequency items and recent interactions.
summary.zh: LoopRec 在序列推荐中反复应用单个权重共享块，并在每个递归边界设置轻量二分类“退出或继续”门，把固定深度变成逐物品的自适应属性；学习到的分配会把更深计算给低频物品与近期交互。

papers.title: Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models

summary.en: LoopLook gives pretrained VLMs encoder-side recurrent perception: a middle-to-late vision-encoder window is revisited with question injection, a learned stopping mechanism sets visual depth, and a token-wise Mixture-of-Looks merges loop representations, gaining up to 8.6% for 5.1-6.5% TTFT overhead.
summary.zh: LoopLook 为预训练视觉语言模型引入编码器侧的循环感知：带问题注入地反复访问视觉编码器中后段，用学习到的停机机制决定视觉深度，并以 token 级 Mixture-of-Looks 融合各轮表示，最高提升 8.6%，首 token 时间仅增加 5.1-6.5%。

papers.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing

summary.en: Looped models build a separate KV cache per recurrence, so inference memory grows with depth. A two-stage recipe uses stochastic-depth pretraining to induce contractive residual dynamics, then BeNice! broadcasts the final loop's cache into the first, matching unshared finetuning perplexity without per-loop caches.
summary.zh: 循环模型每轮递归都会单独生成一份 KV 缓存，推理显存随深度线性增长。该工作采用两阶段方案：先用随机深度预训练诱导收缩型残差动力学，再用 BeNice! 把最后一轮递归的 KV 缓存广播到第一轮，在达到与非共享微调相当困惑度的同时消除逐轮缓存。
